annotations.description: step 1 needs a person: Not 08 Feb: the work rows all read Feb 15 and the first day header is Sun 15/02. But the time axis begins at Sat 14/02 22:00 (ticks 22:00, 23:00, 00:00 ... then Sun 15/02), so the very first axis column is 14 Feb, 2 hours before 15 Feb. No 'Start Date' field on the page. Person to decide if this lead-in counts as Start Date 15 Feb.
